changesApplied.changeMade: Created Metabob MCP integration layer with recordSessionStart() and recordSessionComplete() functions

changesApplied.changeMade: Created session statistics aggregation module with getSessionStats() function
changesApplied.reason: Aggregates message-level metrics (tokens, cost, prompts, tools) into session-level summary for completion tracking. Streams through MessageV2 to extract stats from step-finish and tool parts.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: New file, no dependencies affected. Called by Session.close() to collect stats before recording completion

changesApplied.changeMade: Added MetabobTracking.recordSessionStart() call after Bus.publish(Event.Updated) at line 276-284
changesApplied.reason: Enforces Specification 2 requirement that every session creation must record start event to Metabob MCP. Fire-and-forget pattern ensures tracking errors don't block session creation.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low risk: Call is non-blocking (fire-and-forget), errors logged but don't affect session creation flow

changesApplied.reason: Enforces Specification 2 requirement that sessions must track completion with aggregated metrics. Provides explicit lifecycle method for graceful session termination.
